movie.title: So Long Pluto
movie.overview: In space, a charming little planet named Pluto dreams of joining the Solar System’s official dance troupe. With the help of her asteroid friend, Ceres, and her human discoverer, Clyde William Tombaugh, she will do everything she can to make it happen. In this children’s film, where humans and planets share the spotlight, viewers will accompany Pluto on her quest for fame, until the moment she must face her destiny.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: In a whimsical world where planets and humans interact, a charming little Pluto embarks on a heartwarming journey to join the Solar System’s official dance troupe alongside her loyal friend Ceres and discoverer Clyde Tombaugh.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: In a vibrant universe where celestial bodies and humans coexist, Pluto is a charming little planet with big dreams of joining the Solar System's elite dance troupe. Guided by her trusty asteroid companion, Ceres, and her real-life human discoverer, Clyde William Tombaugh, she throws herself into preparing for the audition of a lifetime. Along the way, Pluto must navigate the lighthearted ups and downs of performative fame while learning where she truly belongs in the cosmos. Ultimately, the journey brings her face-to-face with an unexpected destiny that redefines her place among the stars.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Set in a whimsical children's universe where celestial bodies possess lively personalities, Pluto is a small planet with an ambitious dream: to earn a spot in the Solar System’s prestigious official dance troupe. Deeply inspired by the grand orbits and routines of her cosmic neighbors, she begins training relentlessly to prove that her size does not limit her talent. Assisting her in this quest is her supportive asteroid best friend, Ceres, who offers endless encouragement and practical advice. Adding to her inner circle is Clyde William Tombaugh, her human discoverer, who acts as a caring mentor bridging the gap between Earth and outer space. Together, the trio overcomes various comical obstacles and rehearsal mishaps as they prepare for the ultimate audition before the inner planets. Throughout her journey, Pluto catches the attention of the celestial community, learning valuable lessons about perseverance, self-expression, and the true meaning of stardom. However, as the climax approaches, an unexpected galactic shift forces the cosmic committee to reevaluate what defines a primary planet in the troupe. Rather than letting the dramatic news crush her spirits, Pluto embraces her unique orbital path with grace and joy. In the end, she confronts her destiny with unyielding optimism, celebrating her identity alongside her friends in a heartwarming finale.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: So Long Pluto is an enchanting family comedy-drama that blends astronomical history with imaginative storytelling. The film follows Pluto, a spirited young planet who longs to dance alongside the major worlds of the Solar System. Joined by her loyal friend Ceres—a fellow dwarf planet—and Clyde William Tombaugh, the human who first spotted her in the night sky, Pluto sets out to earn her place in the spotlight. Designed to entertain and gently educate young audiences, the narrative explores themes of ambition, friendship, identity, and acceptance in the face of inevitable change.

story_structure.climax: Pluto faces a pivotal reckoning when she must stand before the cosmic community and confront her true destiny, realizing that her place in the universe might not depend on an official title.
story_structure.conflict: Pluto must navigate the strict standards and shifting definitions of what it takes to be recognized as a full-fledged member of the Solar System's elite lineup.
story_structure.resolution: Pluto learns to embrace her unique identity and place in space, finding fulfillment and celebrating her journey alongside her dedicated friends.
story_structure.introduction: Pluto, a small and ambitious celestial body, dreams of earning a spot in the Solar System's prestigious official dance troupe alongside her supportive asteroid friend, Ceres, and her human discoverer, Clyde William Tombaugh.
story_structure.risingAction: With the guidance of Ceres and Clyde, Pluto embarks on an energetic quest for recognition, performing across the cosmos to prove her worth while facing growing doubts about whether she truly fits the troupe's criteria.
